title: feat(spec): a record page can name the apps whose routes open it (PageSchema.apps)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95mUhXWSnPGxpNDeSMsZmpe)_
Fixes #28979

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：记录页新增可选键 `apps: string[]`。在列出的应用里，该对象的记录视图打开这张页；其它地方(含 Setup)仍打开唯一的 `isDefault` 默认页。同一对象在同一应用里只能有一张：第二张在 defineStack / composeStacks、包注册、元数据保存三道门被拒，点名两张页。
- **为什么改**：裁决 A(#28979，记录 6573557633)。duly 这类应用无法让自己的 `sys_user` 记录页在自己的路由下打开，而改成全局默认会让 Setup → Users 丢掉管理页。
- **风险与回滚**：纯新增键，无旧输入被拒；默认页规则不变(无 `apps` 时行为完全不变)。三道门共用一个读法 `defaultRecordPageObject(page, app)`，错误码沿用 `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`，无新公开名。回滚即 revert 本 PR。控制台尚未读 `apps`(ui 后续卡)，所以合入后界面暂无变化。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/ui/default-record-page.ts`(唯一读法)、`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(注册门按"槽位"计账，默认槽键不变)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`(保存门逐槽判)。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-app-record-page.test.ts`，应见 27 个用例全绿(在 main 上 22 红)。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地(落地前需一次契约复审档复核)。

## What changes

**The key.** `PageSchema` gains an optional `apps: string[]` (app names: lowercase snake_case, at least one, each once; a repeat is refused at the repeat). On a record page bound to an `object`, it names the apps whose routes open this page for that object (`/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID`). Everywhere else, Setup included, the object's one `isDefault` record page still opens. Ruling A on #23015 (one default per object per deployment) is unchanged and no precedence ladder is added: the deployment default and an app's page are two slots, and one page may hold both. The describe carries `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` until the console reads it.

**Placement, the way `isDefault` is gated.** `apps` is refused on any page that is not a record page bound to an object. The one sentence is `misplacedDefaultPageRefusal`'s (it now covers `apps` after `isDefault`), so the page parse (`checkPageDefaultPlacement`, which now reports each key at its own path) and the registry's package door print the same refusal.

**One reading, no new public name.** `defaultRecordPageObject(page, app?)` gains an optional second argument: with an app, it answers the object a record page is the page of inside that app (`apps` lists it). With one argument it is byte-for-byte the old reading. Every door asks it once with no app and once per string entry of the page's `apps`.

**The three refusal doors, one level down.** Each door keeps its existing mechanism and keys it by slot (an object's default, or an object inside one app) instead of by object alone:

- `defineStack` / `composeStacks` (`stack.zod.ts`, `duplicateDefaultRecordPageFindings`): `Object 'X' has two record pages for app 'A' in pages: … Remove 'A' from apps on all but one of them.` (`STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`).
- Package registration (`objectql` `registry.ts` + `default-record-page.ts`): the claims map, the holders reading, the package door and the item seam are keyed by `recordPageSlotKey` (the object alone for the default, so default keys are unchanged). `DefaultRecordPageConflictError` keeps its code (`DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`, 422); a conflict carries `app` when the slot is an app's, and the message names the app with its own remedy. `defaultRecordPageHoldersOf(object, app?)` answers an app's slot.
- Metadata save (`metadata-protocol` `defaultRecordPageSaveRefusal`): judges each slot the saved page holds against the stored rows and the registry's holders; the refusal names both pages and the app and carries `app`. Saving a page under its own name stays an overlay, as for the default.

## Why

An app could not make its own record page over a platform object the page its routes open: plugin-auth's `sys_user_detail` holds `sys_user`'s one default, a second default is refused, and making the app's page the default would take Setup → Users' admin page away from the whole deployment (#28979). Ruling A (director 6573557633, maintainer 「同意」) chose a page-level app scope.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack-app-record-page.test.ts` (new, 27): the key (accepted alone and beside `isDefault`; empty, repeated and non-snake entries refused; refused on a home page, an app page and an unbound record page in the registry door's sentence; both misplaced keys reported); `defaultRecordPageObject(page, app)`; `defineStack` (same app refused naming both; different apps accepted; a page scoped to two apps; default + app page coexist; one page both default and scoped; a second default still reported as a default); `composeStacks` (merged and `preserve`, with controls).
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-app-record-page.test.ts` (new, 10): package door across packages and within one manifest, two-app page, install claim and uninstall release, item seam, environment holder, default and app page side by side, second default still the default's refusal, misplaced `apps` at the package door; each refusal with a control.
- `packages/objectql/src/default-record-page-save-door.test.ts` (+6 per topology, 12): refused over a shipped page and over a stored page for the same app, controls for another app, beside the package default and an overlay by own name, and `apps` on a home page refused by the parse.
- **Forced test edits** (named): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (`page` serves 27 → 28 top-level properties: `apps`); `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (a `planned` omit row for `page.apps`, the `record` / `print` precedent).

## Acceptance notes

- **Follow-ups (not in this PR):** ui: `usePageAssignment` / `appObjectScope.declaredRecordPage` read the route's app first, then the default, then declaration order, with the ruling's two pins (`/apps/THAT_APP/sys_user/record/ID` opens the scoped page; the Setup app's route still opens `sys_user_detail`); the liveness row for `page.apps` flips to `live` there. duly#113: delete the URL-action stopgap once the ui half ships.
- `apps` entries are app **names** (`AppSchema.name`). The Setup app's name is `setup`; `com.objectstack.setup` is its package id. The ui card maps the route's app segment to the app name.
- No cross-reference that a named app exists: a page may scope itself to another package's app, which a one-stack check cannot see. Noted, not filed.
- Generated: `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx`, `liveness/state-counts/page.md`; ledgers: `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` (+5 sites for the array refine, 988 → 993), `liveness/page.json` (`apps`: `planned`).
